posts.title: From the Luddites to AI at Work, How Do We Value People’s Contributions?
posts.description: Looking back at the Luddite movement, I ask how bringing AI into a company changes the way people work, how contributions are recognized, and who gets the gains.

posts.title: Why do companies take different paths through the same wave of technological change?
posts.description: Across five research areas and fifteen lines of inquiry, I look at how firms turn technology into capabilities, how they earn returns, and how capital and collaboration shape their next choices. Company 0 is where I plan to start testing these ideas in practice.

posts.title: From Mine Sites to Plants: A Gold Tailings Visit, November 18–20
posts.description: A three-day visit to Mines No. 1 and No. 2 and the plants in Guizhou and Chenzhou, taking earlier ideas about the full operating chain into specific questions on site and preparations for further validation.
